# MM-P2-L3-RR01 - Maintenance manual - Machining radial ring rolling mill #1

Revision: Rev C  
Plant: P2, line P2-L3  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L3-RR01

Scope
This document defines preventive maintenance tasks and acceptance criteria for machining radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L3-RR01) to ensure safe, repeatable operation of the machining cell. Apply in conjunction with procedures and change notices cited in Related Documents.

Tools
- Adjustable torque wrench capable of 470 N·m
- Bearing grease gun and compatible grease fittings
- Standard set of hand tools and inspection mirror
- Clean lint-free rags and inspection light
- Personal protective equipment per plant standard

Procedure
- Isolate and lock out the equipment energy sources per SOP-P2-L3-01 before any maintenance entry.
- Inspect visible fasteners, guards, and hose routing for wear or damage. Clean contact surfaces and remove debris from the machining area.
- For mandrel clamp maintenance: position the mandrel per machine procedure, and tighten mandrel clamp bolts to 470 N·m using a calibrated torque wrench. Verify bolt seating and clamp alignment visually.
- Lubrication task: service the main roll bearings using the specified grease and fittings. Perform lubrication at the interval of 165 hours of machine operation. Record machine hours and lubrication events in the equipment log.
- Reassemble guards and remove lockout only after verifying all tools and loose items are cleared. Test run per SOP-P2-L3-03 to confirm normal operation.

Acceptance criteria
- Mandrel clamp bolts remain at torque of 470 N·m and show no evidence of loosening or thread damage.
- Main roll bearings show proper grease distribution and no signs of overheating, leakage, or metal contamination after lubrication at the 165 hours interval.
- No abnormal vibrations, noises, or tool runout beyond operator-permissible limits detected during test run per SOP-P2-L3-03.
- Maintenance actions and verifications are recorded in the equipment log and referenced to ECN-2026-018 where applicable.

Related Documents
- ECN-2026-018
- SOP-P2-L3-01
- SOP-P2-L3-03
